scene.description: Name of this video/scene, used to name output files.

reference.description: Path or URL to the reference image/video this list was derived from.

id.description: Unique slug. The generated clip must be saved as clips/<id>.mp4.

order.description: Position in the final edit, starting at 1.

description.description: What's literally in frame in the reference at this beat.

camera.description: Camera motion/framing for this shot (e.g. 'slow push in, eye level').

prompt.description: Full prompt to send to Weave, built from this shot plus the look-bible consistency anchors.
